actual_scope: What exact uniform grid does the complete selected #5413 caller need: the runtime backward body with the #5402 provider expanded, and one 145-axis controller level with its 18 body calls?
scope_change_reason: research/selected-word-exact-grid (merged) certifies the eight-relation body word only. The selected result runs that word inside the #5413 body and controller, whose own precision record (FRESH-PRECISION.json) has only crude heights. This package supplies the exact statement for the complete caller, continuing target 7 of PR #5428.
bottleneck_link: Side result; no new kappa. It replaces the crude precision heights of the selected caller by an exact, attained grid, a precondition for any precision-weighted invoice of the selected construction.
stop_rule: Stop at the exact attained guard of one controller level; the recursive price of the guard is a separate question.
evidence: verify.py expands the #5402 provider inside the #5413 backward body (no odd division, owned fields zero, max v2 = 6 attained: body guard ceil(9 lambda/2)+6), derives the per-port Q from the port wrappers (rank 1, square rank 0, final rows x_p - y_p), replays the controller in its exact Laurent ring and evaluates every cut of the last call with exact nine-plane ranks: the maximum is 73, equal to the requirement of the 224 rank-145 targets, so one controller level needs exactly 73 extra bits. test_verify.py rejects six mutations.
